record.question: What is the main function of a tissue fixative?
options: To preserve cell morphology and prevent autolysis
To harden and stain the tissue
To preserve the tissue for biochemical test
record.explanation: Answer B: To preserve cell morphology and prevent autolysis. Fixation stabilizes tissue structure and slows autolysis and putrefaction so morphology can be examined. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK554382/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
